title: Your qualification. Your keys.
text: This is Veil Pass: one signed qualification that a developer can use to show they meet different requirements. This updated demo runs on the deployed website, with a fresh demonstration holder and a real hosted issuer.

title: One website. Three services working together.
text: Vercel is the website people visit. Render handles credential issuance and status checks. Neon stores the encrypted issuer state. They work together as one product. You only need the Vercel website address.

title: Create a holder wallet.
text: First, we create a demonstration holder wallet. Its signing key is generated in the browser. The issuer receives a public enrollment identity, not the holder's private key. A passphrase protects the encrypted recovery backup.

title: Receive a signed qualification.
text: The authorized issuer approves this demonstration qualification through the live service. The offer is bound to this holder. The browser signs the enrollment, and the issuer returns a signed credential. We now have one qualification in the holder wallet.

title: Check two different requirements.
text: We check approved training, then professional level two. Both checks pass. The generated constraints check the signatures, holder ownership, qualification and current status. These are credential checks on this device; they are not yet public Midnight blockchain proofs.

title: Save, lock and recover.
text: Next, we save the encrypted browser vault and export a recovery copy. We lock the holder, then unlock it with the same passphrase. The qualification is still available. The backup stays encrypted, and the passphrase is never sent to the issuer.

title: Revoked means no access.
text: The issuer now revokes this test qualification through the authenticated backend. When the holder checks again, verification is rejected. A genuine signature cannot make a revoked credential eligible. The demonstration credential is left revoked when the run ends.

title: Working today. One clear next milestone.
text: The hosted credential journey works: issuance, ownership, recovery, policy checking and revocation. The remaining blockchain milestone is deploying the proof flow to Midnight's public pre-production network and testing it with Lace. That needs a suitable prover. This video does not claim that step is already complete.

title: Try the hosted VeilPass build.
text: Veil Pass. Your qualifications open doors. Your private keys stay under your control. Explore the live website and inspect the code and acceptance evidence.
